what_was_done: Patched detectAgentDone in src/lib/agent-launcher.ts to check marker file BEFORE transcript heuristic. Added ~50 lines of marker-first completion detection at the top of the function (lines 520-569): derives markerId from session.beadId or session.epicId+pipelineStage, checks marker file staleness (5-second mtime gate), calls readMarker(), returns true immediately if marker status is terminal (success/failure/needs-decision/blocked). Falls back to existing transcript-based detection if marker missing/too fresh/non-terminal/malformed. Added _testOnlyDetectAgentDone export for test access. Added static import of readMarker from marker-reader.ts (shipped in beads_web-28k, commit a0ebf40). Created __tests__/lib/agent-launcher-marker-detection.test.ts with 6 integration tests covering all AC 5/6 scenarios.
what_was_tested: 6 integration tests all passing: (1) marker-present-terminal-status returns true without reading transcript, (2) marker-too-fresh-fallback skips marker and uses transcript, (3) marker-missing-ENOENT falls back to transcript, (4) marker-non-terminal-status falls back to transcript, (5) marker-malformed (readMarker returns null) falls back to transcript, (6) session-missing-fields skips marker check entirely. Mocked fs.stat, fs.open, readMarker per test case. Full test suite: 1895 pass, 1 skip, 11 fail (pre-existing across 3 suites — see surprises_or_findings). npm run build: PASS.
deviations_from_ac: AC 1 used 'session.markerId' which does not exist on AgentSession type. Implementation derives markerId from session.beadId (per-bead agents) or session.epicId + session.pipelineStage (epic-scope agents). Functionally equivalent — covers both agent types. No other deviations. All 7 ACs verified.
recommendation_for_next: Ready for Wave 1 completion. Marker-first completion detection ships; next Wave 2 bead is beads_web-gc2 (routing interpretation + blocker-class mapping). Wave 2 beads depend on this. Reviewer should verify: (1) marker check short-circuits correctly (test 1 confirms transcript not opened), (2) fallback paths exercise transcript heuristic (tests 2-6), (3) no spillover edits outside detectAgentDone.
surprises_or_findings: PRE-EXISTING-TEST-FAILURE: 3 suites / 11 tests fail before this bead's code landed — (1) agent-launcher.atomic-state.test.ts: 1 test, known C1 regression (pipeline:submission-prep vs pipeline:deploying label mismatch), (2) fleet-config.auto-chain.test.ts: 2 tests, ENOENT on fleet.json (path mismatch for fleet-core), (3) pipeline-routes.test.ts: 8 tests (related to fleet-config path issue). Zero new failures introduced by this bead. SESSION-FIELD-NAMING: Build prompt Context 3 listed session.markerId as a direct field, but AgentSession has session.beadId (per-bead) and session.epicId+pipelineStage (epic-scope). Not a stop condition — derived markerId from available fields.
